mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ekko and his allies gain @spell.Crepe_JinxVsEkko_EkkoReward:AH@ Ability Haste %i:scaleAH% for their Ultimate Abilities.

“Laughter. I'm lucky to hear it.”

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ekko rolls evasively while charging up his Z-Drive. His next attack deals bonus damage and warps reality, teleporting him to his target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ekko dashes and empowers his next Attack to have bonus range, teleport him to his target, and deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Ekko can use any of his other Abilities during the dash.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Primed</titleLeft><mainText>Ekko's next attack will teleport him to his target and deal bonus damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Z-Drive ResonanceEvery third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals @f1@ (+@f2@) bonus magic damage (Cannot be triggered on the same target more than once every @f4@ seconds). If the target is a champion, Ekko gains @f8@% Move Speed for @f9@ seconds.

This deals @f5@% damage to monsters (Max: @f6@).

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every third Attack or damaging Ability on the same target deals an additional <magicDamage>@ThreeHitDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If the target is a champion, Ekko gains <speed>@BonusMS@ Move Speed</speed> for @SpeedDuration@ seconds. This effect can't trigger on the same enemy more than once every 5 seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Temporal Resonance</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been massively slowed by Ekko's Zero Drive.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stolen Time</titleLeft><mainText>Ekko has overloaded his Zero Drive and is moving incredibly fast.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Temporal Sickness</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by Ekko's Timewinder.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Resonance</titleLeft><mainText>If Ekko hits this unit 3 times, he will deal bonus damage and gain a haste.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that expands into a time-distortion field upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing and damaging anyone caught inside. After a delay, the grenade rewinds back to Ekko, dealing damage on its return.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ekko throws a device dealing <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. On hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, it expands into a field that <status>Slows</status> enemies inside by @Effect2Amount*-100@%. After it expands, Ekko recalls it, dealing <magicDamage>@RecallDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ekko turns back time, entering Stasis while teleporting to where he was 4 seconds ago and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies. In addition, Ekko restores <healing>@TotalBaseHeal@ Health</healing>, increased by @PercentHealAmpPerPercentMissingHealth@% for each 1% Health he lost in last 4 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Will detonate the chronosphere from {{ Spell_EkkoW_Name }} [@spell.EkkoW:HotKey@] if Ekko passed through it.
Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are Invulnerable and Untargetable.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Broken Timeline</titleLeft><mainText>Ekko has broken his timeline and is untargetable.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stabilized</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is unable to accumulate Resonance from Ekko's attacks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Ekko's Attacks against enemies below 30% Health deal @MissingHealthPercent@ missing Health magic damage.

Active: Ekko launches a chronosphere lasting 1.5 seconds after a delay that Slows enemies inside by @Effect10Amount@%. If Ekko enters the sphere, he detonates it, Stunning for @Effect2Amount@ seconds and gaining @TotalShield@ Shield.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Bonus Attack damage deals a min of <magicDamage>@Effect6Amount@</magicDamage> and a max of <magicDamage>@Effect5Amount@ damage</magicDamage> against minions and monsters.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Seen It All Before</titleLeft><mainText>Ekko has already seen this timeline and is able to avoid some incoming damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Temporal Suspension</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is frozen in time. WARNING: Avoid the detonation radius of temporal anomalies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
